name: Woody
description: Deep, earthy fragrances characterized by rich notes of cedarwood, vetiver, and creamy sandalwood.
ingredients: Crafted from wild-harvested woods and aged bark oils, evoking the raw depth of an ancient forest.

name: Floral
description: Classic romantic scents centered around delicate blooms like jasmine, damask rose, and Florence iris.
ingredients: Distilled from handpicked early morning blossoms to capture the purest, most dew-fresh floral oils.

name: Citrus
description: Bright, sparkling fragrances bursting with freshness, including zesty bergamot, lemon, and neroli.
ingredients: Cold-pressed citrus peels combined with green botanical extracts for an uplifting, radiant trail.

name: Oriental
description: Warm, sweet, and sensual compositions carrying notes of amber, rich vanilla, and warm spices.
ingredients: Infused with resinous precious balsams and warm spices to construct a highly seductive, lingering scent.

name: Fresh
description: Luminous, light, and airy scents recalling sea breezes, dewy leaves, and clean rain.
ingredients: Formulated with marine accord and crushed mint leaves for a modern, revitalizing, and clean profile.
